body.message:
We have a 2-bedroom apartment available in Aykon City Tower C, Business Bay.

Link: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-aykon-city-aykon-city-tower-c-16180579.html

Rate: AED 10,000 for 30 nights (1 month)

Security Deposit: AED 2000,

The refundable security deposit will be reimbursed within 14 working days after check-out, subject to a property inspection. The refund will be processed by credit card or bank transfer.

Please note that if you wish to extend your stay for additional months, the rates may change depending on the current market conditions.

Thank you.
